correctness.rationale: For each cell, the normalized denominator is the sum of two positive central terms minus two bounded alternating tails; D>5/2. Suffix step responses have exact range [-b/D,1+a/D] by alternating pairing, and every monotone data vector is a nonnegative combination of these suffix steps plus a constant. Since a and b are separately bounded by one-term tails, all cell defects lie below a one-variable rational function F. Its derivative has a unique root in (0,1/2), and elimination yields a unique positive quartic root. n=3 step data at both reflected positions attain the two endpoints. Exact-rational crosschecks for n<=30 and all cells at 34 interior positions, symbolic resultant and floating witnesses passed; they are supplementary to the complete proof.

value.rationale: Shape and range defects matter whenever rational interpolation is applied to bounded monotone observations. The result resolves the sharp worst-case *over every grid resolution* and shows unexpectedly that four nodes are globally extremal even while unrestricted cardinal absolute sums grow logarithmically. It gives an optimal uniform data-range safety margin, sharp witness arrays, and a one-variable algebraic computation. This is a natural stability question rather than an arbitrarily chosen finite slice.
